chunks: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
Jibril, peace be upon him, brought down the siwak, cupping, and khilal.

key_terms.بِالسِّوَاكِ: with the siwak; the tooth-cleaning stick
key_terms.جَبْرَئِيلُ: Jibril, the angelic messenger عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about Jibril عليه السلام bringing down siwak, hijamah, and khilal?
ai.summary: This hadith states that Jibril عليه السلام brought down the practices of siwak, hijamah, and khilal. It indicates that these acts of personal care and cleanliness have a sanctioned place within the transmitted religious tradition.
